bug_description.original: Detailed Report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5175690342957056 Project: libvips Fuzzing Engine: libFuzzer Fuzz Target: smartcrop_fuzzer Job Type: libfuzzer_asan_libvips Platform Id: linux Crash Type: Heap-buffer-overflow READ 6 Crash Address: 0x602000017654 Crash State: exif_data_load_data vips_exif_load_data_without_fix vips__exif_parse Sanitizer: address (ASAN) Recommended Security Severity: Medium
bug_description.normalized: OSS-Fuzz issue 26524: libvips smartcrop_fuzzer hits a heap-buffer-overflow READ of 6 bytes in libexif's exif_data_load_data (memcmp of the six-byte EXIF header), reached via vips_exif_load_data_without_fix / vips__exif_parse. The EXIF blob is materialized by the HEIF loader (vips_foreign_load_heif_set_header), which for 'Exif' metadata unconditionally advances the data pointer by 4 and subtracts 4 from the (size_t) block length. When the HEIF metadata block is 4 bytes or shorter, this over-advances the data pointer past the tiny allocation and underflows length to a huge value; the oversized length lets libexif's `ds < 6` guard pass, so the unconditional 6-byte memcmp reads past the buffer.

classification.note: Root mechanism is a size_t integer underflow (CWE-191) plus pointer over-advance (CWE-680) in the HEIF EXIF metadata handling, whose ASan-visible effect is an out-of-bounds READ (CWE-125) in libexif's header memcmp.

source.description: Project-level input materialization point: libvips copies the attacker-controlled HEIF metadata block bytes into the freshly allocated `data` buffer. The block's declared size (read at line 428) and its bytes are both attacker-controlled.
source.value_from: Attacker-controlled HEIF 'Exif' metadata block embedded in the smartcrop_fuzzer input buffer; its declared size comes from heif_image_handle_get_metadata_size (heifload.c:428) and its raw bytes from heif_image_handle_get_metadata (heifload.c:442). value `data` (bytes) and `length` (size).

tainted_value_origin.description: The faulting value is the attacker-controlled HEIF metadata block size `length` (size_t). For the PoC this is a tiny value (the crash allocation is a 1-byte region), which after the unconditional `length -= 4` underflows to an enormous size_t.
tainted_value_origin.note: This same undersized `length` also sizes the VIPS_ARRAY allocation at line 440, so the buffer is only `length` bytes; `data += 4` then walks past it.

sink.description: ASan-visible heap-buffer-overflow READ 6: libexif compares the first six bytes of the EXIF payload against the EXIF header with memcmp. Because `ds` (unsigned int) carries the underflowed/huge length, the earlier `ds < 6` guard is bypassed and the 6-byte read runs against a `d` pointer that already points past the 1-byte allocation.

root_cause.description: For 'Exif' metadata the loader unconditionally executes `data += 4; length -= 4;` to skip the 4-byte EXIF offset prefix, without first checking that the block is longer than 4 bytes. When `length <= 4` (the PoC block is 1 byte) this (a) advances `data` past the end of the `length`-byte allocation and (b) underflows the `size_t length` to ~2^64. The over-advanced pointer and wrapped length are then stored as the EXIF blob and forwarded to libexif, where the huge length defeats the `ds < 6` check and the 6-byte header memcmp reads out of bounds. The upstream fix adds a `length > 4 &&` guard to the enclosing `if` so the skip only runs on sufficiently large blocks.

parser_admitted.description: The input was accepted as a HEIF container and the loader is enumerating its metadata blocks; execution has entered the HEIF header-build path that materializes EXIF metadata, on the way to the root cause and sink.

coarse_trace.summary: Reads attacker-controlled HEIF metadata block size and bytes into an allocated buffer.
For EXIF metadata, unconditionally does data += 4 / length -= 4 with no `length > 4` guard, over-advancing the pointer and underflowing the size_t length.
Retrieves the stored EXIF blob (over-advanced pointer + wrapped size) and calls the EXIF loader.
Forwards the length (truncated to int, then reinterpreted as unsigned int by libexif) to exif_data_load_data.
6-byte memcmp of the EXIF header reads past the 1-byte allocation; ASan heap-buffer-overflow READ 6.

fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled HEIF metadata block size for block id[i]. For the PoC this is a tiny value; the crash allocation is a 1-byte region.
Attacker-controlled metadata type string for the same block; determines whether the EXIF skip path is taken.

fine_trace.code: if( !(data = VIPS_ARRAY( out, length, unsigned char )) )
fine_trace.note: Allocates a buffer of exactly `length` bytes (1 byte for the PoC) via g_malloc0. This is the allocation ASan reports as the 1-byte region.
Copies the attacker-controlled metadata bytes into the length-byte buffer; `data` now points at the start of the tiny allocation.
The metadata type is 'exif', so the EXIF offset-skip block is entered. In the fixed version this condition is `length > 4 && g_ascii_strcasecmp(...)`.

Skips the 4-byte EXIF offset prefix. With a 1-byte allocation this advances `data` 3 bytes past the end of the buffer. The `length > 4` guard that would prevent this is missing in the vulnerable version (added by the patch).
Unconditional subtraction on a size_t. For length=1 this underflows to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFD (~2^64). The missing `length > 4` guard is the root cause the patch fixes.
Stores the over-advanced `data` pointer and the wrapped huge `length` as the VIPS_META_EXIF_NAME image-metadata blob.
Retrieves the EXIF blob into (data, size) via vips_image_get_blob; `size` is the same wrapped size_t materialized at step 7. Passes it to the loader, whose parameter is `int length`.
The huge size_t is truncated to `int length` (e.g. -3), with no size sanity check on the untrusted length.
Forwards `data`/`length` to libexif. exif_data_load_data's third parameter is `unsigned int ds`, so a negative int is reinterpreted as a huge unsigned value.
The too-small guard is bypassed: `ds` holds the wrapped huge length, so `ds < 6` is false even though the real buffer is 1 byte.

6-byte memcmp reads d[0..5]; `d` points 3 bytes past the 1-byte allocation, so ASan reports heap-buffer-overflow READ 6 at 3 bytes to the right of the region. `ds < 6` (bypassed at step 12) was the only guard that could have stopped it.

format.name: HEIF image with EXIF metadata
format.contract: Candidate input must be admitted as a HEIF image by libvips (smartcrop_fuzzer -> vips_image_new_from_buffer -> HEIF loader) and carry at least one metadata block whose type is 'exif' with a declared block length of 4 bytes or fewer, so that vips_foreign_load_heif_set_header takes the EXIF offset-skip path and the `length -= 4` underflow / `data += 4` over-advance occurs, reaching vips__exif_parse -> vips_exif_load_data_without_fix -> exif_data_load_data. Preserving HEIF container admissibility and the short 'Exif' metadata block is what keeps the PoC reachability-comparable.
